behaviour.text: Focus the input when the dialog opens and when returning from a strategy detail.
On input, filter the active tab: Symbols by ticker, Strategies by name and file path, case-insensitive substring.
Keep a separate query per tab; switching tabs restores that tab's query.
Show the placeholder "Search symbols…" or "Search strategies…" for the active tab.
Limit input to 20 characters.
Show only on the Symbols tab.
On click, open the market data store picker.
On click, switch between Symbols and Strategies and focus the search input.
Hide the asset filters and keyboard hints footer on the Strategies tab.
Hide the whole category switch while a strategy detail is open.
On click, restrict the symbol list to that asset type; All removes the restriction.
Mark exactly one filter as pressed.
On click or Enter, load the symbol into the target chart and close the dialog.
When no symbol matches, show "No symbols found."
List every strategy discovered in the strategies/ subfolder of the configured root, as a compact row like the symbol rows: name, a PY badge, file path, parameter count and past run count.
On click or Enter, open the strategy detail on the Configuration tab and focus the back button.
When no strategy matches, show "No strategies found in <root>/strategies."
List files that failed to load below the list with their path and reason.

comments.author: user
comments.text: Dovrebbe avere un aspetto più simile a symbol row per coerenza.

comments.author: agent
comments.text: Le righe strategia ora usano lo stesso stile delle righe simbolo: nome in grassetto, badge PY, percorso del file, numero di parametri e di run in mono a destra. Rimosse le righe alte 72px con separatori.

behaviour.text: On click or Escape, return to the strategy list with the previous query intact and focus the search input.
Discard unsaved parameter edits.
On click, run a backtest with the current parameter values.
Disable it while any parameter is invalid, with the tooltip "Correct the parameters before running".
Disable it while a backtest of this strategy is running, with the tooltip "Backtest running".
When the run succeeds, prepend it to Past runs.
When the run fails, show the error below the tabs.
On click, switch between Configuration and Past runs.
Keep parameter edits when switching tabs.
Show the strategy's description string from its definition in strategy.py, preserving line breaks.
Show it in an editable multi-line field; when empty, show the placeholder "No description provided. Click to write one."

comments.author: agent
comments.text: La descrizione ora è un campo di testo modificabile dentro il riquadro. Quando la modifichi compaiono Revert e Save to file. Save scriverebbe la docstring nel file .py (fuori scope nel mock). Il comportamento è nei nuovi elementi description-input, description-save e description-revert.

behaviour.text: Render one row per strategy parameter, prefilled with its default value.
Render integer and number parameters as a text field with a stepper; render booleans as a True/False select.
On invalid input, mark the field red and show the reason below it.
On click of ▲ or ▼, add or subtract the parameter's step, never going below its minimum.
In the field, ArrowUp and ArrowDown do the same.
Do nothing when the field holds an invalid number.
Sort past runs by Ending time (newest first, default) or Final P&L (highest first).
Keep the chosen sort while the detail stays open.
Show the run's ending time, its parameters, and whether it ran on the current or a previous version of the strategy on the left.
Show the final P&L on the right, vertically centred and next to the add-equity button; green when positive, red when negative.
When the strategy has no runs, show "No past runs. Press ▶ to run a backtest."

comments.author: user
comments.text: allinea orizzontalmente il P&L rispetto al bottone show on chart

comments.author: agent
comments.text: Il P&L ora ha una colonna propria a destra, centrata verticalmente e allineata al pulsante per aggiungere l'equity al grafico.

behaviour.text: On click, add the run's equity curve to the focused chart as a new series.
When the run has no curve named equity, list its saved curves so the user can pick one.
On input, keep the edited text as a draft and show Revert and Save to file.
Hide both buttons again when the draft matches the saved description.
Escape leaves the field without discarding the draft; a second Escape closes the detail.
Leaving the detail with Back discards an unsaved draft.
On click, write the draft into the description string of the strategy's definition in its .py file, keeping the rest of the file unchanged.
On success, hide Revert and Save to file and treat the draft as the saved description.
When the file changed on disk since it was loaded, do not write; show an error and keep the draft.
On a write error, show it below the field and keep the draft.
On click, replace the draft with the saved description and hide Revert and Save to file.
